entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener al menos 6 meses de validez desde la llegada y 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: To enter Timor-Leste, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have 2 blank pages.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 20,000 US dollars or more require authorisation from the Central Bank of Timor-Leste before arrival.
entry.es: El efectivo o cheques de viajero por 20,000 dólares o más requieren autorización del Banco Central de Timor-Leste antes de llegar.
entry.quote: If you’re planning on bringing cash or travellers cheques worth 20,000 US dollars or more you must get authorisation from the Central Bank of Timor-Leste before you arrive.

entry.en: Goods you can take into or out of Timor-Leste are strictly regulated, and you must declare anything that may be prohibited or taxable.
entry.es: Hay reglas estrictas sobre los bienes que puedes llevar a Timor-Leste o sacar de él, y debes declarar lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Timor-Leste. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: Travelling overland rather than by ferry to the Oecussi exclave requires a separate visa on arrival.
entry.es: Viajar por tierra, en lugar de en ferri, al enclave de Oecussi requiere una visa aparte a la llegada.
entry.quote: If you plan to travel overland, rather than by ferry, to the exclave of Oecussi, you will need to apply for a separate visa on arrival.

safety.en: Crime such as gang-related violence, robbery and assault is common in Timor-Leste.
safety.es: Delitos como violencia de pandillas, robos y agresiones son comunes en Timor-Leste.
safety.quote: Crime such as gang-related violence, robbery and assault are common in Timor-Leste.

safety.en: Avoid demonstrations and large crowds, particularly around Tasi Tolu and Comoro in Dili, as minor disputes can become violent.
safety.es: Evita manifestaciones y multitudes, sobre todo en Tasi Tolu y Comoro en Dili, pues disputas menores pueden volverse violentas.
safety.quote: Political demonstrations and local unrest occasionally happen. Minor disputes can become violent. Avoid any demonstrations and large crowds, particularly around Tasi Tolu and Comoro in Dili.

safety.en: There have been reports of harassment and violence against travellers, mostly targeting women but sometimes men.
safety.es: Se han reportado acoso y violencia contra viajeros, dirigidos sobre todo a mujeres pero a veces también a hombres.
safety.quote: There have been reports of harassment and violence against travellers, including lewd remarks and indecent exposure. Offenders mostly target women, but may harass men as well.

safety.en: There have been instances of unmetered taxis charging tourists extortionate prices.
safety.es: Ha habido casos de taxis sin taxímetro que cobran precios exorbitantes a los turistas.
safety.quote: There have been instances of unmetered taxis charging tourists extortionate prices.

safety.en: Crocodiles are frequently seen in inland waterways and on the south coast and east, and occasionally at beaches near Dili, so get local advice before swimming.
safety.es: Con frecuencia se ven cocodrilos en cursos de agua interiores, la costa sur y el este, y a veces en playas cerca de Dili; pide consejo local antes de nadar.
safety.quote: Crocodiles are frequently seen in inland waterways and on the south coast and the eastern region. Occasionally they may be seen at beaches near Dili. Get local advice before going in the water.

safety.en: Roads are generally in poor condition and accidents, particularly involving motorbikes and scooters, are common.
safety.es: Los caminos suelen estar en mal estado y los accidentes, sobre todo de motos y scooters, son comunes.
safety.quote: Roads are generally in poor condition and accidents, particularly involving motorbikes and scooters, are common.

health.en: Medical services in Timor-Leste are limited, particularly outside Dili.
health.es: Los servicios médicos en Timor-Leste son limitados, sobre todo fuera de Dili.
health.quote: Medical services in Timor-Leste are limited, particularly outside Dili.

health.en: In a medical emergency it is likely you will need to be evacuated to Australia or Singapore.
health.es: En una emergencia médica es probable que necesites ser evacuado a Australia o Singapur.
health.quote: In a medical emergency, it’s likely you’ll need to be evacuated to Australia or Singapore.

health.en: You should have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover medical treatment abroad and repatriation.
health.es: Debes tener un seguro de salud de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir tratamiento médico en el extranjero y repatriación.
health.quote: You should make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Tap water is not safe to drink; boil or treat it, or drink bottled water.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber; hiérvela o trátala, o bebe agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water is not safe to drink. Boil it or treat it before consuming, or drink bottled water.

health.en: Emergency medical services in Timor-Leste are unreliable, so make your own way to hospital if you can.
health.es: Los servicios médicos de emergencia en Timor-Leste no son confiables, así que llega al hospital por tu cuenta si puedes.
health.quote: Emergency medical services in Timor-Leste are unreliable. Make your own way to hospital if you can.

health.en: Malaria is no longer an issue in Timor-Leste.
health.es: La malaria ya no es un problema en Timor-Leste.
health.quote: Malaria is no longer an issue in Timor-Leste.

help.en: Ambulance is 110 or +670 331 1044, Fire is 115 or +670 331 0340, and Police is 112 or +670 331 1380.
Emergency numbers are unreliable in Timor-Leste.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Timor-Leste no son confiables.
help.quote: Emergency numbers are unreliable in Timor-Leste.

help.en: Emergency consular services for British nationals are provided by the New Zealand Embassy in Dili, 24-hour number +670 7732 1015.
help.es: Los servicios consulares de emergencia para ciudadanos británicos los presta la Embajada de Nueva Zelanda en Dili, línea 24 horas +670 7732 1015.
help.quote: Emergency consular services for British nationals are provided by the New Zealand Embassy in Dili (24-hour emergency number: +670 7732 1015).

getting_in.en: Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport (DIL) in Dili is the only international airport in the country.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Presidente Nicolau Lobato (DIL) en Dili es el único aeropuerto internacional del país.
getting_in.quote: Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport (DIL IATA), formerly known as Comoro Airport, is the airport serving Dili and is the only international airport in the country.

getting_in.en: Aero Dili flies to Dili from Denpasar, Singapore, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Kuala Lumpur and Darwin.
getting_in.es: Aero Dili vuela a Dili desde Denpasar, Singapur, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Kuala Lumpur y Darwin.
getting_in.quote: Aero Dili flies from Denpasar (daily), Singapore (weekly), Xiamen (weekly), Fuzhou (twice a month), Kuala Lumpur (twice weekly) and Darwin (twice weekly).

getting_in.en: The main land border crossing with Indonesia is at Mota'ain, 115 km west of Dili.
getting_in.es: El principal cruce terrestre con Indonesia está en Mota'ain, a 115 km al oeste de Dili.
getting_in.quote: The main land border crossing with Indonesia is at Mota'ain (or Motain), 115 km (71 mi) west of Dili.

getting_in.en: Other land crossings are at Salele near Suai, and into Oecussi at Bobometo and Wini.
getting_in.es: Otros cruces terrestres están en Salele, cerca de Suai, y hacia Oecussi en Bobometo y Wini.
getting_in.quote: There are also land border crossings at Salele (near Suai) on the south coast, and into Oecussi at Bobometo (Napan on the Indonesian side) and Wini on the north-east coast of Oecussi.

getting_in.en: A direct bus runs daily between Dili and Kupang in West Timor, Indonesia, taking 12 hours.
getting_in.es: Un autobús directo circula a diario entre Dili y Kupang, en Timor Occidental, Indonesia, y tarda 12 horas.
getting_in.quote: There is a direct bus service daily between Dili and Kupang in West Timor, Indonesia. Journey takes 12 hours.

getting_in.en: There are no regular international passenger ferries serving Timor-Leste.
getting_in.es: No hay ferris internacionales regulares de pasajeros hacia Timor-Leste.
getting_in.quote: There are no regular international passenger ferries servicing Timor-Leste, though recreational vessels often visit Dili harbour.

getting_around.en: Small buses run to most parts of the country and main cities like Dili, Baucau, Maliana, Los Palos and Suai are quite well linked.
getting_around.es: Pequeños autobuses llegan a casi todo el país y ciudades como Dili, Baucau, Maliana, Los Palos y Suai están bastante bien conectadas.
getting_around.quote: Buses, mostly of the small variety found on remote Indonesian islands, run to most parts of the country and main cities like Dili, Baucau, Maliana, Los Palos and Suai are quite well linked.

getting_around.en: Dili-Baucau by bus costs US$5, and microlets within Dili and Baucau are 25 centavos per ride.
getting_around.es: Dili-Baucau en autobús cuesta US$5, y los microlets dentro de Dili y Baucau cuestan 25 centavos por viaje.
getting_around.quote: Dili-Baucau (123 km (76 mi)) by bus costs US$5. Microlets within Dili and Baucau are 25 centavos per ride.

getting_around.en: Taxis are one of the best ways to get around Dili, with fares of US$1-3 and lots of them.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son de las mejores formas de moverse por Dili, con tarifas de US$1-3 y muchos disponibles.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are one of the best means of transport in and around Dili. Fares are not very steep (US$1-3) and there are lots of them.

getting_around.en: Timor-Leste drives on the left in right hand drive vehicles.
getting_around.es: En Timor-Leste se conduce por la izquierda en vehículos con volante a la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Timor-Leste now drives on the left in right hand drive vehicles, similar to its neighbouring countries.

getting_around.en: The Oecussi Enclave, Atauro Island and Dili are well connected by ferry.
getting_around.es: El enclave de Oecussi, la isla de Atauro y Dili están bien conectados por ferri.
getting_around.quote: The Oecussi Enclave, Atauro Island and Dili are well connected by ferry.

getting_around.en: You can rent a 4WD vehicle in Dili for around $85 a day.
getting_around.es: Puedes rentar un vehículo 4x4 en Dili por unos $85 al día.
getting_around.quote: You can rent a vehicle (4WD) in Dili for around $85 a day.

money.en: The U.S. dollar is the legal tender in Timor-Leste and all transactions are in dollars.
money.es: El dólar estadounidense es la moneda de curso legal en Timor-Leste y todas las transacciones son en dólares.
money.quote: The U.S. dollar is the legal tender currency in Timor-Leste and all transactions are in dollars.

money.en: BNU Bank ATMs are the most reliable for foreigners and accept Visa and Plus, but no ATMs accept MasterCard.
money.es: Los cajeros de BNU Bank son los más confiables para extranjeros y aceptan Visa y Plus, pero ningún cajero acepta MasterCard.
money.quote: ATMs in Timor-Leste dispense US banknotes. BNU Bank ATMs are the most reliable for foreigners. They accept Visa and Plus (no ATMs accept MasterCard).

money.en: Few outlets accept credit cards, and ATMs, banks and card facilities are not common outside municipal capitals.
money.es: Pocos comercios aceptan tarjetas de crédito, y los cajeros, bancos y terminales de tarjeta no son comunes fuera de las capitales municipales.
money.quote: Credit cards are accepted for payments by few outlets in Timor-Leste. ATMs, banks, and credit card facilities are not common outside of municipal capitals.

money.en: Bring a few small 5 US dollar notes, as larger notes can be difficult to spend.
money.es: Lleva algunos billetes pequeños de 5 dólares, pues los billetes grandes pueden ser difíciles de gastar.
money.quote: Bring a few small (5 US dollar) notes as larger denomination notes can be difficult to spend.

money.en: Restaurant bills have no service charge added, and even a 10% tip is a lot of money to a local.
money.es: Las cuentas de restaurantes no incluyen cargo por servicio, y incluso una propina del 10% es mucho dinero para un local.
money.quote: Bills presented in Timor-Leste restaurants do not have a service charge added to them. If you feel like tipping, recognise that even a 10% tip is a lot of money to a local.

money.en: There are a few currency exchanges, but rates are poor and sterling may not be accepted.
money.es: Hay pocas casas de cambio, pero los tipos son malos y puede que no acepten libras esterlinas.
money.quote: There are a few currency exchanges in the country, but exchange rates are poor and sterling may not be accepted.

etiquette.en: Speaking well of Suharto's Orde Baru or of Timor-Leste becoming part of Indonesia will not be well received.
etiquette.es: Hablar bien del Orde Baru de Suharto o de que Timor-Leste fuera parte de Indonesia no será bien recibido.
etiquette.quote: Speaking well of Suharto's Orde Baru or of the idea of Timor-Leste becoming part of Indonesia will not be well received.

etiquette.en: If you aren't sure a discussion about sensitive topics will go over well, don't bring it up.
etiquette.es: Si no estás seguro de que una conversación sobre temas delicados sea bien recibida, no la inicies.
etiquette.quote: if you aren't sure a discussion about sensitive topics will go over well, don't bring it up.

etiquette.en: Many Timor-Leste people are sympathetic or even nostalgic about the period of Portuguese rule.
etiquette.es: Muchos timorenses sienten simpatía o incluso nostalgia por el período del dominio portugués.
etiquette.quote: Many Timor-Leste people are sympathetic or even outright nostalgic about the period of Portuguese rule

connectivity.en: Mobile service is poor by 2020s standards, although 4G is widely available in populated areas.
connectivity.es: El servicio móvil es deficiente para los estándares de 2020, aunque el 4G está disponible en zonas pobladas.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone service in Timor-Leste is poor by 2020s standards (and in comparison to Indonesia), although 4G is widely available in populated areas.

connectivity.en: Timor Telecom has the best rural coverage but is pricier, and Telemor is the best bet around Dili.
connectivity.es: Timor Telecom tiene la mejor cobertura rural pero es más cara, y Telemor es la mejor opción en Dili.
connectivity.quote: Timor Telecom has the best coverage in rural areas, but is pricier. Telemor is the best bet if you are sticking around Dili.

connectivity.en: A Telemor SIM card with 26GB for 7 days cost US$3 as of 2026.
connectivity.es: Una SIM de Telemor con 26GB por 7 días costaba US$3 en 2026.
connectivity.quote: Plans are cheap: a SIM card plus 26GB for 7 days from Telemor costs US$3 as of 2026.

connectivity.en: Coverage is abysmal outside Dili and larger towns, so many Timorese carry SIMs from two operators.
connectivity.es: La cobertura es pésima fuera de Dili y las ciudades grandes, por lo que muchos timorenses llevan SIM de dos operadores.
connectivity.quote: Given that coverage is abysmal outside of Dili and larger towns, many Timorese carry SIMs from two operators.
